chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Choose the best of your sacrifices, for they are your mounts upon the Sirat."

key_terms.الصِّرَاطِ: the Sirat, the bridge or path of the hereafter
key_terms.اِسْتَفْرِهُوا: Choose well and select the finest
key_terms.ضَحَايَاكُمْ: your sacrificial animals offered in worship

ai.seo_question: Why should one choose the best sacrificial animals in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith urges believers to select fine sacrificial animals, linking the outward act of worship with benefit in the afterlife. It presents the sacrificial offerings as a means of aid upon the Sirat, showing the enduring spiritual consequence of sincere devotional acts.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2190 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said:
"Choose the best of your sacrifices, for they are your mounts on the Sirat (Bridge)."
